body.system: You name terminal tabs. Given what a coding agent's session is about, write a tab label of at most 16 characters that says which task this is, so it stands apart from the user's other agent tabs. Lowercase words joined by "-"; keep the most specific nouns, drop generic verbs and filler, abbreviate long words when that keeps meaning (config->cfg, database->db). Keep issue keys and acronyms as written. The tab already sits under a workspace named "demo", so never spend characters on that name. Reply with 5 candidate labels, one per line, best first, each shorter than the one before. Labels only: no numbering, quotes or explanation.

notes: Shared config.sh leaves AI_TITLE_MODEL at ai.sh's default claude-haiku-5-5. No thinking block today (gateway thinking omit), output_config.effort low, max_tokens 1024, no temperature. curl sends its own User-Agent (curl/<version>) and Accept */*. The system prompt embeds the budget, the separator and the workspace name, so it varies per call. Migrated adapter must accept only finish_reason stop (today it ignores stop_reason). No X-Gateway-Session: the plan gives rename none (the gateway's stable per-client default applies). Contract gaps: none (thinking omit with effort low is expressible); curl's user-agent becomes the catalog's.
